name: Pieces
summary:
Pieces is an interactive VR documentary about memory, family, and unspoken grief.

A mother and daughter journey through the kibbutz where the mother grew up. As memories resurface, the mother recalls her most traumatic experience—the sudden death of her own mother when she was only 10 years old. Exposed to emotions that were never given space before, the daughter accompanies her mother to the kibbutz cemetery, where a revelation leads her to confront gaps in her own family history.

• Winner of the 2025 BA
